about: Where a tap lands on each tap grid (tap quantize), snapping to the next step or the nearest, straight or swung: for each tap time, when it sounds (at) and the time of the step it belongs to (on), in seconds from a bar, where every grid meets. With nearest, the step just gone counts only for a tap at most late s after it (tap catch). The audio can start at once, so off sounds 5 ms after the tap, and so does a tap that belongs to the step just gone. Triplets are always straight. Written from the clock (mockup/src/libs/sequencing/clock/), on the tool's settings, by tools/make-clock-vectors.js.
